name: What are common reasons to upgrade a shower or tub?

mainEntity.name: What are common reasons to upgrade a shower or tub?

acceptedAnswer.text: Homeowners often upgrade showers or tubs to improve functionality, enhance aesthetics, or address issues like leaks or outdated fixtures. Upgrades can involve converting a tub to a shower, installing a new shower system with modern features, or replacing an old tub with a more comfortable and accessible model. These projects can also increase home value and improve daily living.
acceptedAnswer.description: Common reasons include improving functionality, enhancing aesthetics, or addressing issues like leaks or outdated fixtures.
